column1: # Ghidra function seeds for the 7 addresses OpenSpore cites that Ghidra auto-analysis
# never carved: reachable only through a vtable, and 6 of 7 open with the MSVC SEH
# prologue mov eax,fs:0x0 (Ghidra left those bytes typed as data). Derived by
# tools/gen_seeds.py, which walked each back to the preceding int3 gap to prove they
# are real entries. Already-carved addresses are OMITTED on purpose: per REA's docs a
# seed that overlaps an instruction Ghidra already decoded fails.
